about: Animated patches (format 16, r393, r394; docs/animated-layers.md): a layer's frames drawn after each tile at floor(time x fps) mod their count. Godot draws its own (plax_anim.gd); jME runs core's ParallaxLayer.drawAnim. Written by core/test-data/animated/make_round.py.

scenes.name: flags-mirrored-flipped
scenes.about: r393's probe: a hill with a flag of four colours (frames 0, 1, 2 at 0, 6, 12 s), on an IMAGE layer mirrored above itself and on one flipped on X: the patch mirrored in its tile. The round's teeth: the palms move too little to fail a wrong frame

scenes.name: beach-palms
scenes.about: r365 beach at half size, its palm crowns (l3) carrying r375's 24 frames as a patch at 1.1484 fps

scenes.name: beach-palms-dolly
scenes.about: a02 dollied in from zoom 1 to 0.7: the patch at its layer's own zoom, through DollyBatch

scenes.name: beach-palms-planet
scenes.about: a02 round a planet 400% of the world in radius: the patch bent with its tile, through PlanetBatch
